Build kit for "TOKEN-WITH-H"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
The idea is a part of a page and names no page, so it starts from the app shell. Scaffold it, then put blocks inside it.

name:        shell-top-nav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.
command:     acme astryx template shell-top-nav --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `acme astryx docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

OTHER TEMPLATES
If the layout is wrong, scaffold one of these instead. All page templates: acme astryx template --list --type page

name:        theme-showcase
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Multi-surface comparison shell: preview palettes, typography, icons and control states across a storefront, checkout, chat and inventory on one responsive canvas.
command:     acme astryx template theme-showcase --type page <path>

COMPONENTS
For what the template and blocks do not cover. Read one: acme astryx component <name>

frame:      AppShell, TopNav, SideNav, Layout
foundation: VStack, HStack, Grid, StackItem, Card, Section, Text, Heading, Button, Icon, Badge, Divider

FEW MATCHES
Few matches. This is keyword search, not semantic - try other wordings.
Browse instead:
acme astryx component --list
acme astryx template --list
